articles.title: Multi-vehicle collision closes Hwy. 403 on-ramp in Burlington
articles.summary: A crash involving multiple vehicles has led to road closures on Highway 403 and the QEW in Burlington on Tuesday. The OPP says the collision involves a dump truck and occupants from the vehicles are being assessed for injuries. It is unclear how many people may be injured at this time. articles.title: Tito-Dante Marimpietri elected Oshawa’s next mayor as polls show incumbents re-elected in Pickering, Whitby
articles.summary: Tito-Dante Marimpietri will be the next mayor of Oshawa after cruising to a decisive win, according to the city's unofficial results page.

articles.title: Alvin Tedjo elected Mississauga mayor; Patrick Brown re-elected in Brampton
articles.summary: Alvin Tedjo has been elected mayor of Mississauga, defeating the city's current and former mayors in a closely watched municipal races. Patrick Brown has won a third term in Brampton, while Christina Early is set become Caledon mayor, CBC projects.

articles.title: Police locate vehicle allegedly used by Toronto mother to abduct 3 children
articles.summary: Toronto police say they have found a vehicle believed to have been used to abduct three children from Scarborough on Friday, but the children and their mother have not been found.

articles.title: Brampton man arrested, charged in connection with fatal stabbing in Mississauga
articles.summary: A 35-year-old Brampton man has been arrested and charged in the stabbing death of a 47-year-old Bradford, Ont., man in Mississauga over the weekend.

articles.title: Toronto man sentenced to life with no chance of parole for 16 years in death of filmmaker
articles.summary: A Toronto man has been sentenced to life with no chance of parole for 16 years for killing a filmmaker whose body was found in a trash compactor in Liberty Village more than three years ago.

articles.title: Scarborough's Eric Bauza, modern voice of Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and others, dead at 46
articles.summary: Eric Bauza of Scarborough, Ont., the Emmy-award winning voice actor best known for the iconic Bugs Bunny, has died.
